title: The pot under the leak
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The ranch house roof leaks over the hallway. A pot under it. The dog drinks from the pot. The mother's hand empties it. The strip stays in the hallway all day.

panels.composition: A hallway. A drip from the ceiling drawn as a dotted line. A stockpot on the floor under it. BARNABY looking into the pot.

image.prompt: a hallway with a drip falling from the ceiling into a stockpot on the floor, a small dog peering into the pot, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The dog drinking from the pot. Rainwater. The drip landing on his head.

image.prompt: close on a small dog drinking from a stockpot as a drip lands on its head, black and white, no words

panels.composition: A HAND — the MOTHER's, ring, cardigan cuff — lifting the pot away. The dog's face.

image.prompt: a woman's hand with a ring and a cardigan cuff lifting a stockpot away from a disappointed small dog, black and white, no words

panels.composition: The pot back, empty, under the drip. The dog lying beside it, waiting for it to fill. WOOD in the bedroom door with the pad, drawing the wait.

image.prompt: a small dog lying beside an empty stockpot under a ceiling drip while a young man in a doorway draws the scene, black and white, no words

art.line: brush-pen, committed; black and white; xerox

notes: The hallway leak. The mother's hand talks to the dog, not to Arthur.
